service.description: The local node's link: state (unpaired, connecting, linked, retrying, refused; notBuilt in a binary without the edge link, notStarted in one with it where no HTTP listener started it, as under moqui test), the edge node's URL, the link generation, the round trip of the last Ping on the up connection, when the link last came up, the last error, the links lost since start, and the edge node as its last Hello said, with the pinned fingerprint. nodeRole is this node's node_role; on an edge node linkFingerprint is its own link key's fingerprint.

parameter.name: linkFingerprint
parameter.description: On an edge node, the fingerprint of its own link key (edge_link_key; SHA-256 of the public key, hex), to compare with what a local node's check#EdgeNode shows; empty on any other node. The key itself is never shown.

service.description: Connect to the edge node at url (https://host or https://host:port), check its web certificate by WebPKI, and answer its name, the fingerprint of its link key (edge_link_key), versions and offer, without pairing: for the operator to confirm before pair#EdgeNode. compatible is false, with message, when the link protocol versions are more than one apart.

Pair this local node with the edge node at url, using the one-use code its operator made: make this node's key, have the edge node pin it, pin the edge node's link key (refused when expectFingerprint, the fingerprint check#EdgeNode showed, is given and differs), write edge_node_url, edge_node_key and edge_node_pin to runtime/.env, and bring the link up without a restart. keyFingerprint is this node's key as the edge node pinned it.
Tell the edge node to revoke this node's key (when the link is up), close the link and remove edge_node_url, edge_node_key and edge_node_pin from runtime/.env.
On an edge node: a one-use pairing code for a local node, good for validMinutes (60 by default, at most 1440). The code is shown once; only its hash is kept (moqui.edge.EdgePairingCode).

On an edge node: the paired local nodes (moqui.edge.EdgeClient) with their live links: linked (the up connection is open), down (the down connection too), the generation, the remote address, and the versions of their last Hello.

parameter.name: setup
parameter.description: What the node's last Configure set besides its host names: mailDomains, chatBridgeIds and passSites; empty before one.

service.description: On an edge node: revoke a local node's key and close its link; it can link again only by pairing with a new code. revoked is false when no such node is paired.
On an edge node: a Ping down a linked local node's down connection; rttMs is its round trip.
On an edge node: the public host names of the paired local nodes (moqui.edge.EdgeHost), of one node when pairedNodeId is given.

On an edge node: a public host name for a paired local node, EdgeHostPassthrough (the default) or EdgeHostTerminate; for a name the node has already, its mode changes. The name is saved in lower case with no port; a name another node has is refused. The edge node uses it at once.
On an edge node: remove a public host name; the edge node stops answering for it at once. removed is false when there was no such name.

Queue an item for the other end of the link (moqui.edge.EdgeQueueItem): on an edge node for its local node (pairedNodeId, or the only one paired), on a local node for its edge node. It is delivered once the link is up, in order with the other items of its conversationKey, and applied on the receiver once, by the service its edge queue-kind conf names for kind, in the transaction of its receipt. An idempotencyKey queued already returns that item (created false); with none the item's id is its key. The payload is text (JSON) of at most 1 MiB; contentLocation names a larger body (a dbresource:// file, up to 64 MiB), copied into the item here and sent over the link before it, and its handler gets where the receiver kept it.

The link's queue on this node, by paired node, direction and kind: items waiting, failed, and when the oldest waiting one was queued (of one node with pairedNodeId); whether this node's delivery is paused; on a local node its replicated sets (epoch, last batch acknowledged, changes waiting, whether a full send is due), and on an edge node the cursor of each node's set with its count of records.

Pause this node's queue delivery (paused true, the default) or resume it: while paused, every delivery from the other end is answered "paused" (it is tried again, and not counted as an attempt) and this node's own items wait. Kept in memory: a restart resumes.

On a local node: send every replicated set to the edge node whole again, under a new epoch; the edge node then removes what the full send did not have. On an edge node: forget the cursors (of one node with pairedNodeId), so each node's next batch asks for its set whole. sets is how many.

On an edge node: the copies of a local node's replicated set (moqui.edge.EdgeReplicaValue), of one entity with entityName, of one record with entityName and pk (its key fields), of one node with pairedNodeId; at most limit. Each has its entity, its key and the set's fields of it.

On a paired local node: what its edge node offers it now, asked on the link. offer has publicNames and hostModes (web access), mail (available, mta moqui or postfix, listener, mxHost, bounceDomain, dkimSelector, dkimRecord), chat (webhooks, publicUrl), pass (available, clientId), xmpp (available, port and tlsPort, the tunnel ports edge_xmpp_port and edge_xmpp_tls_port, 0 while off, and otherNode, when edge_xmpp_node names another local node), notAvailable (areas not built yet: calls, sip), addresses (the edge node's public addresses, when it names them) and nodeHosts (this node's host names there now). edgeUrl is edge_node_url. Fails while the link is down.

On a paired local node, the wizard's Apply. The whole setup is checked first (the host names, mail domains, ids and the PASS callback); when any is not input nothing changes. Then the edge node's part goes (Link.Configure); when it is not taken nothing changes on this node either. Then the local rows and settings of each area turned on are written, and every replicated set is sent whole again. Mail: an EmailServer EDGE with smtpHost edge:, SYSTEM's smtpHost edge: when systemMail, and each of emailAccountIds (hosted or shared, with no incoming server of another provider) sending through the edge node; the host or server each replaced is kept (edgePriorSmtpHost, edgePriorServerId) and put back when the node unpairs. Chat: channels_public_url in runtime/.env, the edge node's address. PASS: pass_edge_client and pass_client_(id)_sites and _callback in runtime/.env. Web: hostList (hostName, modeEnumId) is this node's whole list of names on the edge node; a name another node holds is refused there. XMPP (xmppOn): this node's xmpp_domain goes to the edge node (kept in its setupJson), and with web access on it is added to hostList as passthrough when not listed, as uploads (https://domain) and /xmpp-websocket ride on web access; with web access off the edge node must have the name already. Refused before any change when this node has no xmpp_domain or the edge node no tunnel port. Nothing is written locally for XMPP; a line says when this node's xmpp_port or xmpp_tls_port (which Chat apps shows) differ from the edge node's ports. An area turned off is left as it is. Each step is a line of lineList (area, ok, text); one that fails does not stop the others. Refused on an edge node; fails before any change when the edge node's offer cannot be read.

The DNS records a local node behind an edge node needs, each looked up now: for each of domains, MX naming mxHost, SPF that lets the edge node send (mx once the MX names it, a:mxHost, include:mxHost, which needs mxHost's own SPF record, or a network with one of its addresses), the DKIM key at (dkimSelector)._domainkey.(domain) matching dkimRecord, and DMARC; for each of hostNames, A and AAAA naming the edge node's addresses (edgeAddresses, else those of mxHost; a family the edge node lists no address of is not checked); for xmppDomain, _xmpp-client._tcp (with xmppPort) and _xmpps-client._tcp (with xmppTlsPort), each record naming one of xmppHosts (the edge node's names, the first the one to set) and that port; a port of 0 is off and its record not listed. recordList has kind, name, expected, found, ok and a note; _sips._tcp (each domain) and _xmpp-server._tcp (federation, C3b) are listed as later. In a build without the mail client's resolver (the imap feature) it fails, saying so.

parameter.name: mailMta
parameter.description: The edge node's MTA, moqui or postfix: with postfix Rspamd's key signs, which the edge node does not know, so only that a DKIM record is there is checked

parameter.name: xmppDomain
parameter.description: This node's xmpp_domain when its clients come through the edge node; empty for no XMPP records

service.description: On a paired local node, the wizard's Test: the link is up; with mailOn, a round trip on the queue in which the edge node checks that it takes mail for mailAddress (else a hosted or shared account's; not checked when there is none; the answer comes back as inbound mail does), and one in which it takes this node's mail and can send it (its DKIM key with the MTA in moqui, its Postfix relay answering), with the EDGE server, SYSTEM's (with systemMail) and the servers of emailAccountIds on edge:; with chatOn, one in which it checks that it takes the webhooks of chatBridgeIds (not checked with none); with passOn, the PASS client settings name passSites and the edge node has mr-pass; with xmppOn, a client stream through each tunnel port the edge node has on (check xmpp for STARTTLS, xmpps for direct TLS; not checked when off) reaches this node's XMPP server, which must take tunneled connections of that kind, and xmpp_domain is one of this node's host names there (xmppWeb). No outside mail or provider is needed; the answers are waited for up to 10 seconds. testList has check, label, ok, checked and message; passed is true when none failed.

The queue kind edgeEcho, a round trip of the wizard's Test step (test#EdgeSetup): on an edge node the check the payload asks of the local node's copies and its own settings, answered back on the queue; on a local node the answer, kept for the test that waits for it. Granted to _EDGE_.

A delegated call's echo: on the local node it answers its message, the user it ran as (_edge_ for a delegated call) and the caller the edge node named. List it in edge delegate on both nodes to use it.
